header.purpose: The six mandatory CP8 synthetic end-to-end cases with their native (Rust) and Brain (TypeScript) halves. Both halves run as automated tests; the shared contracts (cp8-execution-receipt-transfer-contract.json, cp8-readback-observation-contract.json) plus the shared golden fixtures are the test-only trusted internal bridge. No public IPC was added for E2E (ipc_surface_tests freeze the command registry).

infrastructure.synthetic_write: test-only #[cfg(test)] synthetic write binding (test.cp8.write, medium/L2/reversible_write) mutating a real fixture state file through the hardened CP3 runner; never a production binding
infrastructure.read_only_verifier: test-only ReadbackBinding (test.cp8.readback) with read_only/low/L0 policy observing the fixture via the child protocol; never a production binding
infrastructure.bridge: shared receipt/observation contracts + shared golden fixtures validated by BOTH test suites (cross-language mismatch = 0)
infrastructure.brain_evaluator: deterministic TEST_ITEM_EVALUATOR (test.item.update -> test.item.read), expectations derived only from the approved plan

native_half.asserts: write mutates fixture; receipt Completed exit0; read-back payload reflects the real new state

brain_half.test: Case 1: exit0 with real effect -> VERIFIED

cases.name: exit0 but external state unchanged -> bounded retries then MISMATCH

native_half.asserts: exit 0 + fake stdout, fixture unchanged; read-back payload reflects the real OLD state

brain_half.test: Case 2: exit0 but external state unchanged -> bounded retries then MISMATCH (never verified)
brain_half.asserts: attempt1/2 pending, attempt3 mismatch; 3-attempt history preserved; budget exhausted -> OUTCOME_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED; never default success

cases.name: write changes external state then exit1 -> VERIFIED

native_half.asserts: receipt Completed exit 7; read-back payload reflects the real new state

brain_half.test: Case 3: exit1 with real effect -> VERIFIED (nonzero exit never means no effect)
brain_half.asserts: process_failed receipt opens pending; read-back verifies

cases.name: write changes state then timeout -> VERIFIED

native_half.asserts: child exceeds plan timeout; receipt timed_out; read-back payload reflects the real new state

brain_half.asserts: timed_out receipt opens pending; read-back verifies

cases.name: write changes state then cancel -> VERIFIED

native_half.asserts: child cancelled mid-flight; receipt cancelled; read-back payload reflects the real new state

brain_half.asserts: cancelled receipt opens pending; read-back verifies

cases.name: unknown_after_crash -> readback actual state -> Outcome resolved

native_half.asserts: mid-flight receipts migrate to unknown_after_crash; read-back remains eligible and reflects the real state

brain_half.asserts: opens pending (never not_required); read-back new state -> verified; old state -> mismatch after budget
